div.head: Cn 1018 9
div.ab: Manslagan 7 manswaran. hadbrican. 7 æwbrican. gebugan 7 gebetan. oððe of cyððe mid synne gewitan.
Manslagan and manswaran, hadbrican and æwbrican, gebugan and gebetan, oððe of cyððe mid synne gewitan.
Killers and perjurers, violators of the clergy and adulterers shall submit and make amends, or leave their native land with their sins.
Murderers and perjurers, those who violate holy orders and those who violate their marriage vows shall submit and do penance or leave their native land with their sins.
